judged_text: Same regression as the admin route: setupController calls model.findMembers() without returning or catching the promise, replacing afterModel's awaited version. On the public group members page, a failed members request leaves the table permanently empty with no error shown to the user, and the rejection propagates as an unhandled promise rejection instead of the route error handling the afterModel version exercised.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/routes/group-members.js.es6` the previous `afterModel` hook (which returned `model.findMembers()` and thus let Ember route error handling observe failures) was removed, and `setupController` now calls `model.findMembers();` without returning/catching the promise. Since `Discourse.Group#findMembers` performs `Discourse.ajax(...).then(...)` with no error handling, any rejection won’t be part of the route’s transition promise chain and can surface as an unhandled rejection. Also, the members template was changed to iterate `{{#each m in members}}`, which depends on `findMembers` successfully setting `members`; on failure it will remain unset/empty with no route-level error behavior triggered by this call site.
